final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total_count, AVG(project_count) AS avg_count FROM project_counts) SELECT pc.fundflux, pc.project_count, 1.0 * pc.project_count / t.total_count AS share, pc.project_count - t.avg_count AS excess_over_average FROM project_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE pc.project_count > t.avg_count
